flawed_step: Step 2: Inferring that the s-to-v path in the DFS tree is a shortest path merely because the graph is unweighted. DFS guarantees that discovery depth is the length of its tree path, but it can follow a longer route before discovering a vertex that has a shorter path from s.
assessment_summary: The proof attempt fails at the claim that DFS discovery depth equals shortest-path distance. That property holds for breadth-first search, not depth-first search.
